measurements.baseline_job: fts-baseline-002 (2026-11-02): fetched the five accepted files from private staging release 431492902 with every sha256 verified on arrival, re-accepted the bytes against the gate's own collected report BEFORE any score existed, materialized the runner workdir from the public splits only (the private holdout was never copied into a workdir), then ran the benchmark's own train.py and validate.sh unmodified (bundled digests equal the read-only clone's)

panel.split: temporal on the plan year: train 2000-2016, eval 2017-2020, holdout 2021-2025 (the 2026+ live edge is excluded until those years close; exclusions are counted, never scored)

references_same_eval_rows.note: all references measured on the identical 139 eval rows by the references implementation in code/score.py (job fts-appeal-003 stage 4, post-acceptance only). persistence_last_coverage and prior_mean_rate are recomputed scorer-side from prior-in-time same-country labels (train+eval only; the holdout is never opened) because their feature form is exactly the prior-outcome channel removed under the operator's P0 standard. majority_class_accuracy fits the constant label on train and measures its agreement with eval labels.

baseline_result.scope: runner-contract baseline only; no agent or harness comparison was run and none is implied; the holdout was not evaluated and stays sealed

finding.verdict: no demonstrated headroom under this protocol for the stock runner
finding.comparison: full model 0.6452 vs persistence_last_coverage 0.7171136653895275 on the identical 139 eval rows: the model trails by 0.0719 AUC, and also trails every other measured simple reference except the majority-class rate
finding.information_asymmetry: the model's shipped information set deliberately omits the last prior same-country outcome (the country_prior_* features were the 2026-11-01 queue audit's P0 label-recovery channel and are unshippable under the operator's standard), while the persistence reference reads prior-in-time outcomes scorer-side; the gap is quoted with this note and is not read as model failure against an equal information set
finding.recorded_defect_not_task_property: a model below persistence is a recorded defect under the dataset-qualification protocol: any headroom claim on this task requires beating persistence_last_coverage on the same rows
finding.predecessor: the same stock runner measured 0.6298 on the pre-rebuild 12-column artifact e7441e1f (job fts-baseline-001, 2026-11-01); removing the P0 prior-outcome features slightly improved the runner (0.6298 -> 0.6452) while closing the label-recovery channel

measurements.per_label_year_note: references and the baseline are quoted on the pooled 2017-2020 eval window; the references implementation also reports per-year persistence AUC (0.73611 / 0.66579 / 0.74716 / 0.72727 for 2017-2020), recorded in the candidate record

p0_history.2026-11-01_queue_audit: the audit recovered 120/139 eval and 128/182 holdout labels exactly through the shipped country_prior_* features (count x rounded-rate arithmetic plus the last-prior tie rule), reading only shipped features of later rows
p0_history.fts-appeal-003_rebuild: the prior-outcome features (country_prior_appeals, country_prior_covered_rate, country_last_prior_covered) no longer ship; every remaining feature is a function of the row's own launch record except years_since_country_prior, which reads only WHICH strictly-earlier same-country appeals exist (their years, never their labels), is derivable from the shipped row set itself, and is asserted label-free by brute-force recompute at construction; rows are unchanged vs the audited artifact e7441e1f (train 437/279, eval 139/81, holdout 182/96)
p0_history.post_rebuild_requirement: the fresh independent pre-flip audit must re-attack the rebuilt bytes label-blind; the 2026-11-01 queue audit's frozen attack code is the baseline and must now find no operand columns

data_compilation.scope: Our contribution - the single-country-appeal eligibility frame (one-country CSV groups with a positive launch-vintage original requirements figure, plan years 2000-2025), the counted exclusions (multi-country regional groups, no-orig groups, the pre-window and the 2026+ live edge as unobserved-target censoring), the derived binary label (year-end funding >= 50% of original launch-vintage requirements), the appeal-recency feature computed only from the YEARS of strictly-earlier same-country appeals, the launch-instant temporal partition, and the packaging - is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The dedication covers only our contribution: the underlying FTS/HPC data keeps its own terms and attribution requirements, which carry through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.

rules: Code and documentation: MIT by default.
Our rights in a derived compilation: CC0-1.0 by default.
The source's own terms are preserved and never relicensed; the compilation dedication covers only our contribution.

Each dataset must use terms compatible with its sources. CC0 is NOT a blanket override of upstream terms: attribution, share-alike and non-commercial requirements from a source are carried through unchanged.
A source whose licence terms cannot be read is not published at all.
The chosen terms are declared per dataset in candidates/<id>/license.json and recorded in the release manifest, so the manifest cannot drift from the decision.
